evals.prompt: Create a 6m tree family sharing a leaf atlas with canopy LODs and wind weights for a declared shader.
evals.expected_output: Revision-scoped work or read-only findings with concrete technical and visual acceptance evidence; missing execution is identified.
assertions: Documents wind domain/channels and source pivots.
Checks canopy coverage, alpha edges and target limitations.

evals.prompt: Refine a forest whose low LOD goes bald and whose wind bends the trunk base; triangles already meet budget.
evals.expected_output: Revision-scoped work or read-only findings with concrete technical and visual acceptance evidence; missing execution is identified.
assertions: Prioritizes crown coverage and weight/shader mapping.
Checks alpha overdraw and transitions beyond triangle count.
Preserves reusable masters and reports actual wind evidence.
